messages:
tegan: Quick ask 1: we need a short changelog entry for the new deterministic sampling flag (`seed`) rolled into the inference API. Also a tiny SDK snippet showing usage and a known-issue about mixed-batch determinism. Targeting tomorrow morning release.
michael: Drafted a one-line changelog and put a PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1402. Draft text: "Added optional `seed` parameter for reproducible sampling across calls; see migration notes for SDK usage." PTAL.
nina: I'll add migration notes. Important to call out: when requests are batched on the server, determinism is only guaranteed per-request if batch-scheduling preserves order. We saw a mismatch in stress tests.
nina: Example log showing mismatch (staging):
```
Request A seed=42 -> tokens: "alpha beta gamma"
Request B seed=42 -> tokens: "alpha beta delta"  # mismatch due to interleaving
```
michael: Thanks. For SDK we should show the new param and the helper that pins sampling across streaming reconnects. Tiny snippet added to PR: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(prompt="x", seed=42)
```
tegan: Add a second snippet for streaming with seed and reconnection-safe mode (v0.12.0+). Keep it one code block.
michael: Added: 
```python
# reconnection-safe streaming with seed
client = RedwoodClient(stream_resume=True)
stream = client.chat.stream(prompt="x", seed=42)
for chunk in stream:
    print(chunk.text)
```
nina: Also added a troubleshooting note: "If you rely on strict bit-for-bit reproducibility across requests, avoid mixed workload batching or use Dedicated pools where batching is controlled." Short and to the point.
docs-ci: Preview deployed: https://deploy-preview-1402--docs.redwood.ai (rendered: /releases/seed-param). CI tests passed for docs lint and link-check.
tegan: Can reviewers react with :shipit: or leave nits? Hoping to merge after one more eye.
michael: :shipit: small wording nit fixed in PR (clarified that seed is integer).
nina: :shipit: confirmed the troubleshooting note.
docs-ci: Final build green. Merged and site deploy scheduled at 07:15.
tegan: Thanks team. I'll add the changelog bullet to the release-notes.md and ping product for announcement. Closing thread. :wave:
